problems.why: 払 opens the word here (はらい-もどす), so it cannot sit in a slot whose leading hyphen marks the non-initial form. The other two members of that slot are correct precisely because 払 is non-initial there (支払い しはらい, 酔っ払い よっぱらい). はらい is the ren'youkei of 払う, so the unmarked slot はら.う is its home; the pre-alignment grouping had it there and the rewrite moved it. Sound assignment (払 = はらい) is right either way, so this is a slot/position error, not a wrong reading.

Same as 払い戻す: 払 is word-initial (はらい-こむ) and the leading hyphen on -はら.い reserves that slot for non-initial occurrences. The い is the ren'youkei okurigana of 払う. Pre-alignment had it under はら.う; the rewrite moved it because only the -はら.い slot literally writes い.

notes: Everything else in the range checks out reading-by-reading. Spot notes on the cases that could have gone wrong:
痛: 痛み/いたみ is under いた.む (correct — み is む's stem, not い's); 痛い/いたい under いた.い; 痛める/いためる under いた.める. This is the case the prompt flags and the rewrite gets it right (pre-alignment had 痛み under いた.い).
押: 押入れ/おしいれ correctly under お.し- with 押 spanning おし (送り仮名の省略 — the compound drops the し). Pre-alignment credited only お. Improvement.
恐: 恐らく/おそらく correctly moved to おそ.る (classical 恐る + ク語法) instead of おそ.れる. Improvement.
絶: 絶えず/たえず is the ず-negative of 絶える, so た.える is right; 途絶える/とだえる takes rendaku た->だ non-initially.
倒: 面倒/めんどう under トウ with rendaku ど[う]; 面倒くさい/めんどくさい correctly left in irregular — the colloquial contraction めんど has no clean ト/トウ account.
欠伸/あくび and 息子/むすこ are genuine 熟字訓 and belong in irregular where they sit.

越: 引っ越す, 追い越す, 乗り越し etc. sit in the unmarked こ.す slot while -こ.す / -ご.し stay empty. Not reported: an unmarked slot carries no positional constraint, so a non-initial word in it violates nothing (unlike 払 above, where the constrained slot is the one being used).
願: お願いします/おねがいします moved from -ねがい to ねが.う. Not reported for the same reason — ねが.う is unmarked, and ねがい is the ren'youkei of 願う, so nothing false is taught; the -ねがい slot merely goes unused.
抱: 抱っこ/だっこ under だ.く (only だ-span slot) and 抱く/いだく under いだ.く — the two spans are correctly told apart by the kana.
居: 芝居/しばい correctly in the leading-hyphen -い slot (居 non-initial); 居る appears under both い.る and お.る as separate vocab, both correct.
等: 等々/とうとう, 平等/びょうどう (rendaku), これ等/これら in -ら (non-initial, hyphen honored) all correct.
雑: 大雑把/おおざっぱ under ザツ with 促音便 ざっ; 雑巾/ぞうきん correctly under the separate ゾウ reading.
No word in this range is filed under a nanori reading.
